name: WF-309 — Verified Close → Final CRM Closeout & Assignment Profit Record

'blocked' : blockers.length ? 'blocked' : !identityReady ? 'incomplete' : !closeDate ? 'incomplete' : !profitInputsValid ? 'invalid_profit_inputs' : netProfit < 0 ? 'negative_profit_review' : 'closeout_ready'; const crmActivity = {activity_type:'verified_close_final_crm_closeout',deal_id:dealId,lead_id:leadId,property_id:propertyId,close_id:closeId,status,close_date:closeDate,gross_profit:grossProfit,closing_costs:closingCosts,net_profit:netProfit,assignment_profit_record:{deal_id:dealId,close_id:closeId,gross_profit:grossProfit,closing_costs:closingCosts,net_profit:netProfit,close_date:closeDate},portfolio_feedback:{signal:netProfit > 0 ? 'positive_close' : netProfit === 0 ? 'breakeven_close' : 'negative_close'},blockers}; return [{json:{...deal,workflow_id:'WF-309',workflow_name:'Verified Close → Final CRM Closeout & Assignment Profit Record',status,verified_close:verifiedClose,identity_ready:identityReady,profit_inputs_valid:profitInputsValid,gross_profit:grossProfit,closing_costs:closingCosts,net_profit:netProfit,assignment_profit_record:crmActivity.assignment_profit_record,portfolio_feedback:crmActivity.portfolio_feedback,crm_activity:crmActivity,next_workflow:status === 'closeout_ready' || status === 'negative_profit_review' ? 'WF-310' : status === 'blocked' ? 'WF-126' : 'WF-308'}}];
